historical_record.description: The 24,900-square-foot property, with 275 feet of frontage on Van Ness Avenue, held a gas and oil service station at the Greenwich corner and a retail apparel store at the Lombard corner. The City Planning Commission, by a 6-1 vote, disapproved a conditional use for an automatic car wash with gasoline pumps that would have replaced the service station and apparel store on the site.
